HTTP::method
Description
Returns the type of HTTP request method. This command replaces the
BIG-IP 4.X variable
http_method
.
Syntax
HTTP
::
method
HTTP::method
Returns the type of HTTP request method. Common HTTP methods are
described in
RFC2616 Section
5.1.1
.
Examples
Log the HTTP request method:
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
"HTTP Method: [HTTP::method]"
}
